item.title: Obenski: The enemy within
item.description: It is exhausting. Every day, there’s a new outrage, something that pleases the MAGA minority, but offends others’ sense of decency. The longer official misbehavior goes on, the more we can begin to accept it as normal. Will faceless troopers in the streets replace hometown police?

item.title: Ask Angi: How should I budget for home projects?
item.description: Budgeting is one of the most important skills a homeowner can have. Planning ahead and budgeting for home projects can help prevent unexpected costs and ensure your projects go smoothly from start to finish.

item.title: Design Recipes: Kitchen trends
item.description: This is shaping up as a “back to basics” year for kitchen trends. While technology and innovation remain top of mind, when it comes to trends that will shape renovations, timeless and elegant is taking center stage.

item.title: Malinin fails to win gold; Shaidorov shocks field
item.description: MILAN — Kazakhstan’s Mikhail Shaidorov emerged as the shock winner of the men’s competition at the Milano Cortina Games on Friday as heavy favourite Ilia Malinin’s free programme fell apart and he finished out of the medals in one of Olympic figure skating’s biggest upsets.

item.title: White House orders Homeland Security shutdown as funding lapses
item.description: WASHINGTON — The White House ordered the Department of Homeland Security to begin shutdown procedures as its funding from Congress expires at midnight — the third time parts of the U.S. government will have shut down in the last six months.

item.title: US spent $35 million to send deportees to Third World
item.description: The Trump administration spent more than $35 million to deport roughly 300 migrants to countries they had no connection to, doling out millions of dollars in lump-sum transfers to foreign governments without a system to track how the money was used, according to a report released Friday.

item.title: Hawaii opens its baseball season with another dramatic victory
item.description: On Friday the 13th, the Hawaii baseball team took advantage of Gonzaga’s misfortune to pull out a 3-2 victory in 10 innings at Les Murakami Stadium.
